section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1974
title: 10 Volume of accidental deaths per one lakh of population in the States, Union Territories & Metropolitan Cities The volume of accidental deaths per one lakh of population for the States as a whole for 1974 was 18.67. For Union Territories, it was 34.87 and the all-India average was 18.88. The Maximum volume of accidental deaths per one lakh of population was 42.12 for Metropolitan cities.
